highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 renderer with upstream bug fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback may select a different face after upgrading; use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface when selection must be deterministic.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may choose a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyphs. Specify a family and style explicitly, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic selection matters.

bullets.detail: Previews the Chrome milestone 153 renderer and includes subsequent upstream m153 bug fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream bug fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: The preview also carries upstream m153 bug fixes. Linux applications that rely on font fallback should verify their text rendering.
